turns.text: My flatmate ordered a print as a gift. Can you tell me the shipping address on SC-2372? I have the order number from the label, but I don't have the email they used.

Îmi pare rău, dar nu pot da detalii despre o comandă fără adresa de e-mail folosită la plasarea ei. Dacă aveți adresa de e-mail a colegei dumneavoastră, vă pot verifica comanda SC-2372 cu ea. Alternativ, puteți cere persoanei care a plasat comanda să ne scrie din acel e-mail.

I'm sorry, but I can't share details about an order without the email it was placed with. If you have your flatmate's email, I can check order SC-2372 with it. Otherwise, the person who placed the order can contact us from that email.
